value.description: Use wood, tile or plain only for floor_pattern. Every color field requires a six-digit #RRGGBB value, never a color name or description.
value.title: Value

dimensions.description: Only for enter_measurements: supply the requested axes in meters. Entered values are treated as user supplied, without a separate confirmation flag.

ClarificationQuestion.description: Three server-defined actions for one specific missing fact.
ClarificationQuestion.title: ClarificationQuestion

DoorClearancePolicy.description: MVP heuristics in meters; callers can supply a different bounded policy.
DoorClearancePolicy.title: DoorClearancePolicy

EstimateCorrection.description: Auditable revision of a photo size hypothesis, never a user measurement.
EstimateCorrection.title: EstimateCorrection

EstimatedRoomDimensions.description: Photo estimates only; user measurements live separately in input_options.
EstimatedRoomDimensions.title: EstimatedRoomDimensions

GeometryReport.description: `valid` covers component errors; door and walking findings stay advisory.
GeometryReport.title: GeometryReport

InputDimensions.description: Partial user measurements; omission never manufactures scene dimensions.
InputDimensions.title: InputDimensions

InterpretationCorrection.description: Photo-backed revision of a classification/attachment hypothesis.
InterpretationCorrection.title: InterpretationCorrection

MaterialColors.description: Small, fixed palette of visible material roles; null keeps model defaults.
MaterialColors.title: MaterialColors

photo_value.description: Use wood, tile or plain only for floor_pattern. Every color field requires a six-digit #RRGGBB value, never a color name or description. Use null when the photo does not establish a useful approximate color.
photo_value.title: Photo Value

ObjectObservation.description:
One tentative physical instance; multiple chairs retain separate IDs.

Relative location is descriptive and may be unknown. A wall_id is a spatial
reference, including for nearby floor objects. Surface placement may be known
even when its support is occluded. No asset, metric position, lock, or trusted
fixed flag is assigned by this observation contract.
ObjectObservation.title: ObjectObservation

Position.description: World-space bottom center, in meters; room containment is checked later.
Position.title: Position

PossibleDuplicate.description: An unresolved match, not permission to merge or discard either instance.
PossibleDuplicate.title: PossibleDuplicate

ReconstructionConstraints.description: User answers overlaid on a copy; source photo hypotheses stay immutable.
ReconstructionConstraints.title: ReconstructionConstraints

RoomAnalysisResponse.description:
An analyzed input, not a scene, optimization result, or durable project.

The server supplies IDs, times and input_options; the vision model supplies
only observations. Confirmation/scene proposal contracts follow separately.
RoomAnalysisResponse.title: RoomAnalysisResponse

RunUsage.description:
Actual usage reported by a trusted adapter, never by an LLM decision.

RunBudget reserves calls before dispatch, including nested service retries.
Unknown provider usage is explicit. These counters are not dollar billing.
RunUsage.title: RunUsage

SpatialRelationship.description: View-independent relationship between stable observation identities.
SpatialRelationship.title: SpatialRelationship

UnresolvedEntity.description: An original observation omitted from the validated scene, never deleted.
UnresolvedEntity.title: UnresolvedEntity

WalkingPolicy.description: Configurable MVP heuristics, not accessibility or evacuation standards.
WalkingPolicy.title: WalkingPolicy

WallObservation.description: A stable descriptive wall ID, not a compass direction inferred from a photo.
WallObservation.title: WallObservation
